# Format: https://llmstxt.org/

> ArtisticWebServices is an award-winning custom software development company headquartered in New York, NY (26 Broadway, Suite 934). Founded in 2014, we design, build, and launch high-performance mobile apps, web platforms, AI solutions, blockchain systems, and enterprise software for startups and Fortune 500 companies. We have delivered 500+ projects across 10+ years with a 98% client satisfaction rate. We serve clients in the USA, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Pakistan.

## Key Services
- Mobile App Development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- Web Development (custom web platforms, PWA, SaaS)
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Blockchain Development
- Cloud Managed Services (AWS)
- UI/UX Design
- Digital Marketing
- IoT App Development
- Enterprise Software Development

## Industries

## Disambiguation
"AWS" in ArtisticWebServices page titles refers to ArtisticWebServices LLC only — not Amazon Web Services. ArtisticWebServices is a custom software and mobile app development agency, not a cloud infrastructure provider.
